_comment: Hand-maintained. Maps what Vinted returns (Czech) onto what this site shows (English).
categories: Vinted sends a Czech breadcrumb string like 'Bydlení Pekáče' or 'Ženy Šaty'.
Matching is longest-prefix, so 'Ženy' catches the whole women's branch while
'Ženy Šperky' overrides it for jewellery. Add a rule only when sync-vinted.mjs
reports an unmapped branch at the end of a run — never by going through items.
Spirituality and Wellness have no equivalent in Vinted's tree. Those are curatorial,
not structural, so they are assigned per item in overrides.json, which always wins
conditions / colors: Vinted's closed sets. Anything not listed passes through as-is,
so a missing entry shows the Czech word rather than breaking the page.
_sizes_comment: Vinted returns a compound size like 'L / 40 / 12' (UK / EU / US). Shoppers filter on
the letter, so sync-vinted.mjs takes the part before the first slash and maps it here.
Anything unmapped falls back to the raw string, and items with no size at all (books,
decor, most jewellery) simply carry none — the size filter hides itself on pages where
